description: On the red bedspread in front of you are a yellow plate, a small plush keychain toy, a small white figurine, a blue spoon, and a couple of small flat pieces. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the plush toy (making it the right-hand object), lifts it up and carries it leftward and downward, then sets it onto the center of the yellow plate and releases it; the left hand is not involved.
